inlineSql: SELECT A.AC_CODE,A.AC_NAME,C.AC_MOBILE,A.VCH_NO,A.PACKET_NO,A.DHRN_BILL,A.CO_YEAR,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_DATE,A.DHRN_AMT,A.INT_PRC,A.GOLD_WT,A.GOLD_DESC,B.ISU_LC,B.ISU_YRCD,B.ISU_DBCD,B.ISU_NO,SUM(B.DHRN_REC_AMT) AS DHRN_REC_AMT,SUM(B.UNCHAK_DHRN_REC) AS UNCHAK_REC,A.OLD_ISU_NO,A.DHRN_MONTH FROM ((DHRN_ISU_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN DHRN_DATA AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.ISU_LC AND A.CO_YEAR = B.ISU_YRCD AND A.CO_BOOK = B.ISU_DBCD AND A.VCH_NO = B.ISU_NO)LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = C.AC_CODE)LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS D ON A.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = D.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = D.CO_BOOK WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LOAN_TYPE = ' ? ' AND A.ENTRY_TYPE = 'D' ? AND A.AC_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.PACKET_NO = ' ? ' ? C ? AND D.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? And A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? GROUP BY A.AC_CODE,A.AC_NAME,C.AC_MOBILE,A.VCH_NO,A.PACKET_NO,A.DHRN_BILL,A.CO_YEAR,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_DATE,A.DHRN_AMT,A.INT_PRC,A.GOLD_WT,A.GOLD_DESC,B.ISU_LC,B.ISU_YRCD,B.ISU_DBCD,B.ISU_NO,A.OLD_ISU_NO,A.DHRN_MONTH HAVING SUM(A.DHRN_AMT) - SUM(B.DHRN_REC_AMT) > 0 ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE

SELECT A.CO_YEAR,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_NO,SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN A.ITM_FINE ELSE 0 END) AS GlFine,SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN A.ITM_FINE ELSE 0 END) AS SlFine FROM DHRN_ISU_DETL AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' and A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? CO_YEAR ? ' AND A.CO_BOOK = ' ? CO_BOOK ? ' AND A.VCH_NO = ' ? VCH_NO ? ' GROUP BY A.CO_YEAR,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_NO

SELECT A.AC_CODE,A.ISU_YRCD,A.ISU_DBCD,A.ISU_NO,SUM(A.INT_AMT) AS IntAmt,SUM(A.INT_REC_AMT) As IntRec,SUM(A.DHRN_REC_AMT) As DhrnRec,SUM(A.UNCHAK_DHRN_REC) As UnchakRec FROM DHRN_DATA AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' and A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.AC_CODE = ' ? AC_CODE ? ' AND ISU_YRCD = ' ? CO_YEAR ? ' AND A.ISU_DBCD = ' ? CO_BOOK ? ' AND A.ISU_NO = ' ? VCH_NO ? ' GROUP BY A.AC_CODE,A.ISU_YRCD,A.ISU_DBCD,A.ISU_NO
SELECT * FROM DHRN_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND ISU_YRCD = ' ? CO_YEAR ? ' AND ISU_DBCD = ' ? CO_BOOK ? ' AND ISU_NO = ' ? VCH_NO ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? AC_CODE ? ' ORDER BY TO_DATE DESC

SELECT A.AC_CODE,A.AC_NAME,A.VCH_NO,A.DHRN_BILL,A.CO_YEAR,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_DATE,A.DHRN_AMT,A.INT_PRC,A.GOLD_WT,A.GOLD_DESC,B.ISU_LC,B.ISU_YRCD,B.ISU_DBCD,B.ISU_NO,SUM(B.DHRN_REC_AMT) AS DHRN_REC_AMT,SUM(B.UNCHAK_DHRN_REC) AS UNCHAK_REC,A.OLD_ISU_NO FROM (DHRN_ISU_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN DHRN_DATA AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.ISU_LC AND A.CO_YEAR = B.ISU_YRCD AND A.CO_BOOK = B.ISU_DBCD AND A.VCH_NO = B.ISU_NO) LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS D ON A.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = D.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = D.CO_BOOK WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LOAN_TYPE = ' ? ' AND A.ENTRY_TYPE = 'D' ? AND A.AC_CODE = ' ? ' ? C ? AND D.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? GROUP BY A.AC_CODE,A.AC_NAME,A.VCH_NO,A.DHRN_BILL,A.CO_YEAR,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_DATE,A.DHRN_AMT,A.INT_PRC,A.GOLD_WT,A.GOLD_DESC,B.ISU_LC,B.ISU_YRCD,B.ISU_DBCD,B.ISU_NO,A.OLD_ISU_NO HAVING SUM(A.DHRN_AMT) - SUM(B.DHRN_REC_AMT) > 0 ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE

SELECT A.AC_CODE,A.ISU_YRCD,A.ISU_DBCD,A.ISU_NO,SUM(A.KASAR_AMT) AS KasarAmt FROM DHRN_REC_DATA AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' and A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.AC_CODE = ' ? AC_CODE ? ' AND ISU_YRCD = ' ? CO_YEAR ? ' AND A.ISU_DBCD = ' ? CO_BOOK ? ' AND A.ISU_NO = ' ? VCH_NO ? ' GROUP BY A.AC_CODE,A.ISU_YRCD,A.ISU_DBCD,A.ISU_NO HAVING SUM(A.KASAR_AMT) > 0
Select * From USER_SET WHERE LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND USER_NAME = ' ? ' AND SUB_MENU = ' ? '
SELECT EMP_NAME As SchmName,EMP_CODE as Code FROM EMP_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY EMP_CODE
SELECT VCH_DATE,FINE_GL_RATE,FINE_SL_RATE FROM RATE_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY VCH_DATE,FINE_GL_RATE,FINE_SL_RATE ORDER BY VCH_DATE DESC

UPDATE A SET A.DHRN_REC_AMT = B.DhrnRec, A.UNCHAK_DHRN_REC = B.UnchakRec FROM DHRN_ISU_DATA AS A INNER JOIN(Select CO_CODE, ISU_LC, ISU_YRCD, ISU_DBCD, ISU_NO, SUM(DHRN_REC_AMT) As DhrnRec, SUM(UNCHAK_DHRN_REC) As UnchakRec FROM DHRN_DATA GROUP BY CO_CODE, ISU_LC, ISU_YRCD, ISU_DBCD, ISU_NO) As B On A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.LC_CODE = B.ISU_LC And A.CO_YEAR = B.ISU_YRCD And A.CO_BOOK = B.ISU_DBCD And A.VCH_NO = B.ISU_NO And A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? '
Select * From AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT AC_NAME As AcNameL,AC_CODE As AcCodeL, AC_GR AS GroupL,AC_ADD1 As AddressL,AC_PHONE As PhoneL,AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_GR ='15' ORDER BY LC_CODE,AC_NAME

SELECT Sum(CR_AMT - DR_AMT) as BalAmt FROM AC_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? ' and VCH_DATE < ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? C ? AND DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? HAVING SUM(CR_AMT-DR_AMT) <> 0
SELECT BOOK_NAME ,CO_BOOK ,BOOK_TYPE,ITM_TYPE,MAIN_BOOK,BOOK_SNAME,BOOK_INOUT,MENU_NAME FROM BOOK_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? '
